span.p: adminForward targets dto.targetEmployeeId if supplied, else the user matching recordCreatedBy. If neither resolves no warning is sent, but status still becomes FORWARDED.

div.style: text-align: center; white-space: break-spaces; display: table; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; width: 200px;

span.p: RESOLVED and REJECTED are terminal: forward/resolve/reject/apply throw CorrectionAlreadyProcessedException. Soft-delete via removedAt; @Version guards concurrent admin edits.

div.style: text-align: center; white-space: break-spaces; display: table; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; width: 200px;

span.p: Representative of the nine entity-level audit tables. Append-only: repositories expose save only, no update or delete path.

div.style: text-align: center; white-space: break-spaces; display: table; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; width: 200px;

span.p: Only the distinguishing columns shown. No entity snapshot, one filterSummary TEXT instead; actor/session/request/details/occurredAt block identical to AudioAuditLog.

div.style: text-align: center; white-space: break-spaces; display: table; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; width: 200px;

span.p: Only the distinguishing columns shown. Snapshot describes the TARGET user and the role/permission delta, not an archive entity; same actor/session/request block.
